frame.origin: centre of the reproduced district, in the tunnel's floor plane (MP_caseF.png 'Origin')
frame.z: +z up from the TUNNEL FLOOR, full scale; the readme's rule is height above ground = z - 10 m (the model was raised, QUESTIONS.md QF4); tunnel planes at z = 15 / 19 / 30 m, field anemometers at z = 13 ... 21 m
frame.wind_direction_rotation: compass FROM-direction (N = 0, E = 90): N blows toward -y; flow_dir = (-sin WD, -cos WD). Not defined in the readme; the reference-building choice (SMB for NW-NE) and the upwind-roughness check support it, and at NNW a solved field corroborates it (status 'corroborated by a solved field'; the other directions stay 'unverified').
frame.length_scale: FULL-scale metres (model 1:800): the tunnel's model-scale coordinates and the STL are multiplied by 800; the field's are published in full scale

files.format: ASCII STL, LF, metres, same frame as points.csv
files.source: BD_caseF.stl (Zenodo; terrain + buildings of Nov 1978) scaled x800 from model to full-scale metres and re-wound outward; 53,814 triangles, open along the rim of the 725 m disc (812 boundary edges at z = 0, the tunnel floor); closed here with a base slab: vertical walls from the rim down to z = -1 m and a bottom cap at z = -1 m (2,436 added triangles); 3 zero-area triangles are removed and the neighbour across each is split
